avis.texte: Loved this cetaphil Gentle Exfoliating SA Cleanser. For all skin types. Gently exfoliates and cleanses to promote daily skin surface renewal for smoother more even looking skin. The cleanser has cilic acid, mandelic acid and PHA. It defends against weakened skin barriers, dryness, irritation, roughness, tightness. I've been using this nightly for a few weeks now and it seems to make a difference in my nightly routine.

avis.titre: Good for gentle daily wash and exfoliator
avis.texte: Here are my takeaways! Pros: ✅Gently exfoliates & gentle overall v Get smooth skin ✅Great for all skin types, espically for folks with sensitive skin like me! ✅Fragrance free, hypoallergenic, paraben free ✅Easy to use pump ✅Value size bottle Cons: ❌My skin felt squeaky clean but it was a bit too much for my dry skin ❌I was hoping this would remove makeup well but it was okay; had to follow up with my DHC oil cleanser to finish the job, if I wore makeup
i love this cleanser. it's very effective and the texture feels amazing. it's hard to find products that don't break me out or irritate my skin but this is amazing.

avis.titre: Cleans skin well and helps exfoliate!
avis.texte: I've been excited to try a new facial wash as I want something that both cleanses but also helps my skin barrier and sensitivity. I love that it does the exfoliating of rough dry skin without harsh physical exfoliants or micro plastics. The salicylic acid is great for acne prone skin and I've been having my teen son also use to help keep his skin both clean and hopefully blemish free as he continues to mature. So far it's been working well for him and I and I love that it's not harsh on his younger skin, nor does it have a fragrance. Definitely will buy again!
I really enjoyed this facial wash. It did a great job of cleaning my skin without being over drying. It also helped With my texture n made my face appear more even
